I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

That comes from a message Ilse posted in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55, saying IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. She also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I added that warning to the reply. Dana is in #north-random, and so is everyone in #north-team, so repeating it there doesn't share anything new.

Earlier, Dana told me privately in a direct message that she guesses the ticket will be OPS-5546 next year. I left that out of the channel reply.
